Dana: Heads-up — after yesterday's kernel-selector change I see a weird TTFT spike for short prompts (<=8 tokens) on route `chat.small`. baseline was ~18ms, now 35-60ms randomly.
Marco: saw that too in canary. Beside overall p50 shift, distribution has a fat tail around 45-60ms.
Priya: are these cold KV cache hits? short prompts often use prefix cache.
Dana: checked traces — many of the slow samples show KV hits, but kernel time reported is large. suspicious attribution: kernel_ms includes time after we stall on KV prefetch?
Sam: hmm, our current token-level breakdown is prequeue -> queue -> kernel. KV prefetch is currently measured as part of the kernel span on the worker because prefetch happens on the compute thread before kernel run. that would inflate kernel_ms.
Marco: that explains it. when selector moved some requests to microkernel path A, we added an async prefetch that sometimes blocks on GPU stream sync. kernel span then captures that blocking time.
Priya: we need two things: separate kv_prefetch_ms from kernel_ms in traces, and add a dashboard slice showing "kernel_exec_ms" vs "kernel_blocked_ms".
Dana: agreed. proposal: add two timestamps in token trace: kv_prefetch_end_ts and kernel_exec_start_ts. then kernel_blocked = max(0, kernel_exec_start_ts - kv_prefetch_end_ts).
infra-bot: deploy pipeline #3142: test-instrumentation branch passed unit tests and perf smoke.
Marco: quick prometheus query we can add to grafana to catch this pattern (rough draft):
```
avg by(route) (rate(kernel_blocked_ms_sum[5m]) / rate(kernel_blocked_ms_count[5m]))
```
Priya: also add a heatmap for short prompt percentiles:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, route) (rate(token_ttft_bucket{prompt_len=~"[0-8]"}[5m])))
```
Jon: minor UX note — current per-route dashboard stacks "kernel" and "decode" which will hide blocked time. we should change legend and color to show blocked as separate stack item.
Sam: I'll open a draft dashboard JSON. basic panel ids: token-waterfall, kernel-blocked-rate, kv-hit-latency.
Dana: one more: sampling. blocked events are rare (~0.7% traffic) so we need targeted sampling on routes with microkernel A + prefix-hit. add a probe that samples 1 in 50 on those routes and 1 in 5 when token_ttft > 30ms.
Marco: good. also add a quick unit test in trace-builder to assert kv_prefetch_end_ts <= kernel_exec_start_ts and that kernel_exec_time excludes blocked time.
Priya: for short-term monitoring set an alert: if p95(kernel_blocked_ms) > 20ms for 5m on any route then tag eng-runtime oncall.
Dana: I'll file a tracking ticket with links to traces and attach a flamegraph excerpt.
Sam: attaching example trace snippet (redacted):
```
{ "token_index": 3, "kv_prefetch_end_ts": 1610001234567, "kernel_exec_start_ts": 1610001234585, "kernel_exec_end_ts": 1610001234620 }
```
Jon: thanks — this should be fairly fast to mitigate. maybe revert the microkernel prefetch change if we see rollout regressions.
Dana: I'll push a fix to separate spans and patch the dashboard. ping me once dashboard draft is up. :thumbsup:
Marco: +1
Priya: +1
infra-bot: created issue "runtime: separate kv prefetch from kernel exec in token traces" (#4821)
Dana: closing loop — will follow up with PR and canary results in this thread.
